metadata.ep_title: Configurable Secret Rotation and Workload Identity Federation for the Secrets Store CSI Driver

missing_elements: Impacted repositories not formally listed: openshift/api is the source of the CSIDriverConfigSpec extension (PR #2846 referenced by link only); the operator repo is implied but no explicit 'Impacted Repos' section names both.

RBAC blast radius not discussed: adding tokenRequests support means kubelet will provide SA tokens to the driver. No analysis of whether the operator's existing RBAC (secretproviderclasses_role.yaml already has serviceaccounts/token verbs) is sufficient or whether any new RBAC is needed.

OLM/CSV changes not mentioned: the EP adds new spec fields to ClusterCSIDriver. No discussion of whether config/manifests/ CSV metadata needs updating (alm-status-descriptors, relatedImages, specDescriptors).

quality_issues.quote: When omitted, this means no opinion and the platform is left to choose a reasonable default, which is subject to change over time.
quality_issues.suggestion: The implementation notes section says 'currently 120 seconds' but the API doc says 'subject to change over time'. These are consistent but users reading only the API doc cannot know the current default. Consider pinning the default value in the API comment (e.g., '// +kubebuilder:default=120') or explicitly stating the current default value in the API doc string to reduce operator surprise.

quality_issues.quote: Risk: Setting minimumRefreshAge too low could overwhelm the external secret provider with API calls. Mitigation: OpenShift document will suggest users to choose a wise value.
quality_issues.suggestion: The mitigation is documentation-only. Consider whether the operator should emit a status condition warning (e.g., 'RotationIntervalBelowKubeletSyncFrequency') when minimumRefreshAge < 60 (kubelet syncFrequency), giving operators a machine-readable signal in ClusterCSIDriver.status without blocking the configuration.

gaps: RBAC: secretproviderclasses_role.yaml already grants serviceaccounts/token — confirm no additional RBAC is needed for SA token projection via tokenRequests
OLM/CSV: new ClusterCSIDriver spec fields should be reflected in alm-status-descriptors in the CSV; EP does not mention config/manifests/ changes
Network policy: no new ports introduced — explicitly confirm no NetworkPolicy changes needed (low risk but worth stating)

non_blockers: Impacted repositories list missing openshift/api as explicit dependency (referenced via PR link only)
RBAC blast radius analysis absent — unlikely to require new permissions but worth confirming
OLM/CSV changes not addressed — likely minor but should be captured in tasks
minimumRefreshAge API doc could pin the current default value for clarity
